html:
The Malayan Union was a British plan of 1946 to join the Malay states, Penang and Malacca into one colony, with equal citizenship for all races and the sultans stripped of power.

Malays saw it as a threat to their rights and rulers. Across the peninsula they protested, and in May 1946 Onn Jaafar founded the United Malays National Organisation (UMNO) to fight it.

Britain gave way. In 1948 the Union was replaced by the Federation of Malaya, which restored the sultans and made citizenship harder for Chinese and Indians. UMNO went on to lead the country into independence and to rule it for sixty years. See Straits Settlements and Chinese migration.
sum: The Malayan Union was a British plan of 1946 to join the Malay states, Penang and Malacca into one colony, with equal citizenship for all races and the sultans stripped of power.
